title: Gratitude Themes Word Cloud
dataSources: Mood entries (`mood:entry`), meditation sessions (`meditation:session`), journal entries (`journal:entry`), gratitude logs (`gratitude:log`).
app: Mood, mindfulness and journaling apps — Daylio / How We Feel mood exports, Headspace / Insight Timer meditation logs, journaling and gratitude entries — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gratitude:log
| eval theme=lower(theme)
| stats count as mentions by theme
| sort - mentions
| head 20
description: Counts the recurring themes in your gratitude entries, reflecting back what you most often appreciate.
value: Seeing your gratitude themes ranked is a quietly powerful reminder of what truly matters to you.
implementation: Ingest gratitude entries with themes into `index=personal`; rank the most common themes.
visualization: Word-cloud or bar chart of gratitude themes.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers the things you are most often grateful for, gently reflecting back what matters to you.
